name: Oedema leads to OTP
description: Workflow: workflow-child.json (followup 1 always -> anthropometry; followup 2 oedema_status = yes and age < 60 -> otp_admission; copy rules of anthropometry: muac -> last_muac, oedema -> oedema_status, visit_number -> visits__int__; visit_number is computed by the form from the prefilled _visits__int__). Forms: form-child_registration.json, form-anthropometry.json, form-otp_admission.json.

steps.description: 11-month-old boy registered at the health centre
Back 2 weeks later with swelling on both feet
